import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')
sub = df[df.account_id=='CZ4NH6K'].copy()
# baseline period before anomaly: e.g., Sep 1 - Oct 12; anomaly period Oct 13 onward
pre = sub[sub.date < '2025-10-13']
post = sub[sub.date >= '2025-10-13']
for col in ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']:
    g = pd.DataFrame({
        'pre_avg': pre.groupby(col).unblended_cost.sum()/pre.date.nunique(),
        'post_avg': post.groupby(col).unblended_cost.sum()/post.date.nunique(),
    }).fillna(0)
    g['diff'] = g.post_avg - g.pre_avg
    print(col)
    print(g.sort_values('diff', ascending=False).head(8))
    print()

import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')
sub = df[df.account_id=='CZ4NH6K'].copy()
pre = sub[sub.date < '2025-10-13']; post = sub[sub.date >= '2025-10-13']
g = pd.DataFrame({'pre': pre.groupby(['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']).unblended_cost.sum()/42,
                 'post': post.groupby(['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']).unblended_cost.sum()/21}).fillna(0)
g['diff']=g.post-g.pre
print(g[g['diff'].abs()>15].sort_values('diff',ascending=False))
# also check price changes anywhere
pr = pd.DataFrame({'pre': pre.groupby(['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']).price.mean(),
                  'post': post.groupby(['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']).price.mean()})
pr['pdiff']=pr.post-pr.pre
print(pr[pr.pdiff.abs()>0.05])

{"code": "import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')
sub = df[df.account_id=='CZ4NH6K'].copy()
pre = sub[sub.date < '2025-10-13']; post = sub[sub.date >= '2025-10-13']
g = pd.DataFrame({'pre': pre.groupby(['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']).unblended_cost.sum()/42,
                 'post': post.groupby(['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']).unblended_cost.sum()/21}).fillna(0)
g['diff']=g.post-g.pre
print(g[g['diff'].abs()>15].sort_values('diff',ascending=False))
# also check price changes anywhere
pr = pd.DataFrame({'pre': pre.groupby(['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']).price.mean(),
                  'post': post.groupby(['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']).price.mean()})
pr['pdiff']=pr.post-pr.pre
print(pr[pr.pdiff.abs()>0.05])"}
